title: Containment pattern for compound icon actions: ephemeral-loading slot & ghost focus under theme flip
creator: Asha Iyer
description: Problem: Multiple regressions and inconsistent behaviors observed across compound/icon+label buttons when actions enter deferred/loading states and when the user flips system theme (light/dark/high-contrast) or uses RTL locales. Symptoms include: layout shift when a loading spinner replaces an icon; focus ring disappearing or doubling (ghost focus) during state transitions; token mismatches for background/foreground when a button overlays a translucent loading mask; and missing touch-target stability on compact icon clusters. Goal: define a single, low-complexity containment pattern that (1) reserves an ephemeral loading slot to prevent layout shift, (2) preserves an accessible focus affordance (ghost focus) that survives state transitions, (3) bubbles minimum token override rules to ensure correct colors across theme flips and high-contrast, and (4) provides clear implementation guidance for engineering and QA to avoid regressions across platforms.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec and tokens: a single pattern file describing ephemeral-loading-slot, ghost-focus, and token overrides published to design system docs.
Visuals: Figma comps for "compact icon", "icon+label", "split-action" sizes: default, loading, disabled, focused with ghost ring, and theme-flipped high-contrast.

Engineering contract: CSS/token mapping + runtime fallback strategy documented with example classes and JS hooks; a minimal set of new tokens (loadingWidthReserve, loadingOverlayAlpha, focusGhostRingWidth) introduced.
Regression tests: automated visual diff snapshots covering LTR/RTL and light/dark/high-contrast for the 3 sizes; threshold tolerances documented.
Accessibility: keyboard focus visible and announced state changes; aria-live guidance for long-running actions; WCAG contrast verified for ghost focus in high-contrast themes.
No layout shift: measured CLS-like test shows < 0.02 shift for common sequences where a click triggers loading, across desktop and mobile breakpoints.
Rollout: feature flag + canary on design-2026.03 release with rollback playbook documented.
Implementation PR: at least one engineering PR reference with passing unit/visual tests before closing the ticket.
Docs: Migration notes for any component that relied on previous ad-hoc loading replacement behavior (e.g., existing split buttons).
Design review: sign-off from accessibility lead (Marissa Chen) and frontend lead (Diego Flores).
comments: 2026-03-10 — Asha: Filed after triage with product; observed multiple customer-facing regressions in recent release where icon-only actions jumped when a spinner was inserted. Initial repros on Dashboard and Console routes. Captured screenshots and short recording in Drive.

2026-03-11 — Marco: Quick spike showed 3 viable approaches: reserve width equal to largest icon+spinner width; fade spinner in over translucent overlay; or animate skeleton-to-spinner with transform to hide shift. Preference leaning toward reserve width + overlay for simplicity and minimal reflow.

2026-03-11 — Marissa (a11y): Note: preserve focus visibility across transitions; do not remove focus ring when toggling loading. Recommend ghost focus that draws outside the overlay and uses distinct stroke token to meet contrast in HC mode.

2026-03-12 — Design: Uploaded Figma file "button-ephemeral-loading-v1" https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/button-ephemeral-loading-v1 — contains token mapping page and three component variants. Team: review frame at 2026-03-15 10:00 UTC.

2026-03-13 — Eng feedback (Diego): Engineering prefers CSS-only fallback for reserve-width using inline logical-size token (loadingWidthReserve) and animated opacity for spinner; wants small JS hook for aria-live and to handle long-running cases where we show progress text.

2026-03-13 — Trade-off discussion: Reserve width prevents shift but increases visual "dead" space; overlay approach keeps layout tight but needs careful pointer events management. Decision: default to reserve slot for compact/icon and icon+label sizes; overlay strategy optional for split actions where we can maintain label visibility.

2026-03-14 — Design update: Added token proposals in the Figma token page: loadingWidthReserve: 28/36/44 (px) mapped to compact/regular/large; loadingOverlayAlpha: 0.12; focusGhostRingWidth: 2px; focusGhostToken: interactive-focus-strong. Added notes for RTL: use inline logical properties (padding-inline-start/end) and ensure spinner alignment uses inline-end for icon-on-the-right variants.

2026-03-14 — PR reference (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/4287 — initial CSS and visual tests. Engineering requested additional test cases for RTL and HC. I added test checklist in PR comments.
2026-03-14 — QA plan: Visual test matrix created (Drive): light/dark/HC x LTR/RTL x compact/regular/large x default/loading/disabled/focused => 72 snapshots. Assign QA: Lina Park.

implementation_notes: Introduce three new tokens: loadingWidthReserve (logical px), loadingOverlayAlpha (float), focusGhostRingWidth (px). Map tokens to existing theme contract so they flip with dark/light/HC.
Use inline logical CSS (width: var(--loadingWidthReserve); min-inline-size fallback) to avoid LTR/RLT discrepancies.
Spinner should be positioned with inline-end alignment and absolutely centered in the reserved slot; spinner enters with opacity animation and pointer-events none when overlay is used.

Focus ring (ghost) must render above the loading overlay. Implement by rendering focus ring as outline on a parent layer with higher z-index than overlay, using mix-blend if necessary to hit contrast in HC.
Avoid layout shift by always reserving the slot for icon presence; for buttons without icons (label-only), no reserve needed.
Add aria-live region guidance for long-running actions and ensure screen readers announce state change only once to avoid verbosity.
Include visual regression snapshots for LTR/RTL and HC in CI gating for the release branch.
Migration: Add deprecation notes for patterns that replaced icon with spinner by swapping DOM nodes; recommend switching to reserved-slot pattern.
Fallback: For older browsers without CSS logical support, provide small JS polyfill to set inline style width on mount.
Performance: Keep CSS layers minimal; overlay alpha should be low to avoid repaints; measure paint cost on heavy lists (Console route).
